name: web-cream-studio-hero-with-black-3d-fold-and-pink-cta
title: Cream studio hero with monospace headline, chrome-black 3D fold on yellow and pink button
whatItIs: A black-framed page with a beige rounded nav bar and a cream hero. A monospace headline 'Crafting your fantasies with a twist' has a black pill image inline. A pink pill button with thick outline and arrow circle sits below. On the right a glossy black 3D fold sits on a yellow square with a circular rotating 'Get in touch' badge. A row of grey logos runs below.
whatItMeans: Playful and tactile; monospace type and chunky buttons feel indie and confident.
techniques: Embed a small image pill inside a headline.
Use chunky outlined pill buttons with a separate arrow circle.
Put a dark glossy 3D object on a flat yellow tile.
Add a circular text badge as a secondary CTA.
Keep logos in grey below hairlines.
bestFor: Brands mixing 3D objects with flat colour

vocabulary.definition: A tiny picture placed within a line of text.
Text set around a circle with an icon at centre.
A pill with an attached arrow circle.
A solid rounded block behind a 3D object.
